results.snippet: The convergence of vision, language, and action modeling has catalyzed a paradigm shift in robotic manipulation, enabling robots to interpret natural language commands and execute complex tasks through learned sensorimotor policies. This comprehensive review synthesizes recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for robotic manipulation, establishing a systematic taxonomy spanning end-to-end transformer architectures, diffusion-based policies, and modular frameworks. We analyze foundational models including RT-1, RT-2, PaLM-E, Octo, and OpenVLA, e…

results.title: Gaussian2Sim: Generating Robot Vision-Language-Action Data from Real-World 3D Gaussian Splatting
results.snippet: Training generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires large, diverse and precisely action-labelled data, yet real-robot teleoperation is costly and conventional simulation lacks photorealism. We present Gaussian2Sim, a real-to-sim pipeline built on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that decouples reconstructed scenes into physically interactive, object-level assets with collision geometry and physical properties, populates them with tasks and language generated by a large language model, and re-renders simulated states into photorealistic RGB-D observations. The pipeline runs on AMD R…

# 具身智能与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）前沿调研报告

**日期**：2026-11-16（UTC）  
**领域**：Embodied AI / Vision-Language-Action (VLA) / Robot Foundation Models  
**检索源数量**：36 条可引用来源（其中高度相关 12 条）  
**方法论**：deep-research + frontier-tracking + paper-survey + evidence-grading + frontier-watch

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 核心模型与端到端规划范式的最新增量

| **Gaussian2Sim** | 2026-01 | SSRN 预印本 | 基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的真实到仿真管线，将真实场景解耦为可物理交互的物体级资产，直击 VLA 大规模训练数据瓶颈 | citations=0 (预印本) [2] | SSRN (未同行评审) | 低 | ★★★☆☆ | [2] |

> **增量判断**：2025-2026 年出现「人类视频→机器人动作」直连范式 [1] 与「3DGS 驱动真实到仿真数据生成」工程路线 [2]，均为近 1 年新增探索方向，但均处于预印本或会议早期阶段，**真机大规模验证仍缺失** > 待核实。

### 1.2 基准建设与评测维度扩展

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

### 4.1 三层核心瓶颈（数据基础设施层面）

| **基准层** | 缺乏推理能力评测：现有基准多为行为克隆式任务，非推理泛化 [9] | 评测设计滞后于模型能力，缺乏「难负例」「组合泛化」「反事实」测试集 | LLM 评测范式迁移（MMLU→VLA-Reason）、程序化生成难任务 | [9] §6.2 | 高 |
| **数据引擎层** | Scaling Generation ≠ Scaling Grounding：数据量↑ 但对齐质量↛ [9] | 缺乏自动化验证回路，人工标注 grounding 不可扩展 | 自动化验证器（VLM-as-Judge、物理引擎校验）、RLHF-for-VLA | [9] §6.3 | 高 |

| 瓶颈 | 现状 | 拐点候选 | 证据来源 | 确定性 |
